patterns.note: Uses vibrant, multi-color linear gradients for hero backgrounds, call-to-action buttons, and prominent text elements to create visual energy.
Alternating full-width sections with either solid white or gradient backgrounds, containing content within a consistent central max-width container.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background with a subtle shadow, while an initial top announcement bar disappears.
Key headings feature a gradient text fill, emphasizing important phrases and adding a modern, dynamic feel.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent, taller state to a shorter, sticky bar with a solid white background and a subtle drop shadow upon scrolling past the initial hero section.
Sections are structured with a consistent maximum content width, centered on the page, and utilize alternating background colors or gradients to visually separate content blocks.
Gradient text effects are applied to prominent headings, using a linear gradient fill that matches the site's vibrant color palette.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with gradient fills, paired with clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and card corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with a slightly airier hero section and consistent vertical spacing between content blocks.

standout: The distinctive use of vibrant, multi-color linear gradients, not just for backgrounds and buttons, but also directly applied to prominent heading text, creates a dynamic and energetic visual identity that stands out from typical SaaS marketing sites.
